description: Our state is seeing an unprecedented rise in the cost of living. We are feeling this even more here in Suffolk County. It is undeniable that the costs our families face are higher now and the money our residents make is simply not going as far.And with one-party control in Albany, that trend will likely continue with their senseless approach to energy costs, business regulations that harm our small businesses and the never-ending spending on illegal migrants which is the result of the nation'
